  context={"endpoint"}
>

</MethodEndpoint>



A connector that authenticates per user is listed as the calling admin, with the request's own bearer token, through the connector-gateway. Its refusals carry a code: 403 admin_not_granted (the gateway does not serve the connector to the admin: the admin is in no group granted it, or the gateway is not serving it) and 409 admin_connect_required (the admin must connect to the connector's upstream provider first). 422 means this installation cannot list per-user connectors at all.
